Speaker A: Madam, this is not the correct office. Can you please show me your ID?
Speaker B: No English. Slow slow ga cheppandi. Nenu interview ki vachanu. [No English. Speak slowly. I came for an interview.]
Speaker A: Madam, as I told you this is not the correct office. The location is clearly mentioned in the paper. You have to go straight, and you will find it.
Speaker B: Are wah sir. Meeru security guard ayi intha manchiga English ekkada nunchi nerchukunnaru? [Wow sir. Being a security guard, where did you learn such good English?]

Naaku recent ga bonus kooda vachindi madam. Adi naa English maatladatam valla. [Earlier, even I didn't know how to speak in English. By using this SpeakX app, I am able to speak easily. That's why I speak with everyone in the office. I also recently got a bonus, madam. That's because of my English speaking.]
Speaker B: Emannaru? SpeakX app aa? [What did you say? SpeakX app?]
Speaker A: Avunu, aa app lo oka AI teacher untundi. Nenu free time lo ten to fifteen minutes practice chesanu. Dani valla nenu ye coaching class ki vellaledu, ye course kooda teesukoledu. Ila choodandi, meeru evarini kalavadaniki vacharu? [Yes, there is an AI teacher in that app. I practiced for ten to fifteen minutes in my free time. Because of that, I didn't go to any coaching class, nor did I take any course. Look here, who did you come to meet?]
AI Voice: Who are you looking for?
Speaker A: Eeroju interview postpone ayindi. [Today's interview is postponed.]
AI Voice: The interview has been postponed today.
Speaker B: Wah! Idi chala easy ga undi. Kani idi konchem costly ga untundemo kada? [Wow! This is very easy. But maybe this is a bit costly?]
Speaker A: Ledu madam. Ee app ki seven days trial ki two rupees maatrame. [No madam. For this app, a seven days trial is only two rupees.]
Speaker B: Avuna? Nenu ippude ee app download chesukuntanu. Ippudu naa interview clear cheyadam evvaru aapaleru. [Is it? I will download this app right now. Now, no one can stop me from clearing my interview.]
